def test_bf():

    assert bf("Earth", "Mars") == ()

    assert bf("Mars", "Venus") == ("Earth",)

    assert bf("Earth", "Jupiter") == ("Mars",)
    assert bf("Mercury", "Mars") == ("Venus", "Earth")
    assert bf("Mercury", "Neptune") == ("Venus", "Earth", "Mars", "Jupiter", "Saturn", "Uranus")

    # Multiple planets in between, reverse order
    assert bf("Jupiter", "Earth") == ("Mars",)

    assert bf("Earth", "Earth") == ()

    assert bf("Earth", "Pluto") == ()
    assert bf("Pluto", "Earth") == ()
    assert bf("Foo", "Bar") == ()
    assert bf("", "Earth") == ()

    # Case sensitivity: lowercase names are invalid
    assert bf("earth", "Mars") == ()
